eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Opéréli lèèri ba yirika korfè djourou min bè yélé bara konon bénan djinni wa anpouli yélé tè nan kè tougouni.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Yelebarani kakan ka fale. Djanto yerela kakan ka korossi yelebarani falenan.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Ka djumlan, curan ta mènin yôrô kakan ka tugu waliman ka curan djuru bô.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Wé yé kèla sababouya mi na wé lé couran lé bè woyo ka do djigan do konon, wé djigan konon nèguè dow lé bè ampoulou conon, ni djin ka sé we neguè man couran do i la gbirigbiri fagan la ni y ka tougou neguè wé konon non yoro la waliman amoulou wé dougouman yôrô la mi yé djigan we konon yé.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Djoussoukoun lé ko ka gbrè djolibôssira sissitèmi la mi bé bassi fiè môgô ya farila.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Djéri mi bôra sonnô ka woyo djéridjourou rô mitôgô sondjourou ido ségui sonma djéridjourouw miw tôgô djérifinsira. Djerifinsiraw bèrô dôgôman tôgôko Capiyèriw.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Triceratopw gni toun bé na sé ka bînw dôrôpén gnimi n'ga hali yiribolow fasa dèrè ani liliw.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Lônikèlaw do kô triceratopiw tumbé cycads, le domuna, cycads yé filaburu sugu dô mi.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Yiri suw ni nugu boni be tehe yiri fitini dola. Yiri mi flabru be kuru komi bavla.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratopi dô tumbésé ka a da fanga kè ka filaburuw boyi kasôrô ka yiri domu.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Lonnibaga dow ko baga be yiride togowla ola sissan aka gbele dinosorow tou be a domou, ali ni biterela makoundo ni toukonnon sogo gberew inafo soloni (dinosorow bonson) besse ka bagaman yiribourou ni yiridew domou.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: lo, Jupiteri ya sateliti dô ta Munumunu bésé kané saman tchogodi? Nii kii yere sôrô lo kounan, itésé ka gbiriya komi nii bé dugukolo kan.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Môgômi soumara 200 pounds (90kg) dougoukolo kan toumbéna souma 36 pounds (16kg) lo kan. O touma, soumanleya, ko-sôbè, fitchini lé samana irô.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Fara te tile la yo Dougou koro zango ambe se ka tagama a kan. Tile danna ni gazi ani tassouma ani plasma le ye.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gazi be dôgôyala ni be ka mataga téré tchèmala la.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Tile faan min an ba ye ni an be a filɛ tɔgɔ lo ko fotosifɛri min kɔrɔ ko “yeelen balɔn”.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Ko San Biwôro kôfè, ya 1610 Galilleo Galilei italian dô ka telescopeta ka Venus tagama tchogo flè, yomi kalo é akè.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: yèlèmayèlèmatchogo nun be kè walasa yeelen be Venus fan dôrô kan (tari kalo fan) min gnè gban ni be tile la. Venus yèlèmayèlèmatchogow tun be Copernicus ya miiriya tchogo lafasa. O miiriya tôgô ko tile nôfèlolow be munumunu tile dafè.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: O kôfè, san daman timini san 1639, Anguilê sananfèn kalanbaga mi tôgô touyén Jeremiah Horrocks yé djoumalolo katagama dôw mafilê.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Angilètèri tèmè nan hèrè wagati djan dô la tuma mi nan o ka Danelaw minè kôtugu.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: tunbè san kinmin kônnondôn bi kônondo ni kélé toubè viking cônouba yanfè ba kamlan Guyhrum touman ni tinminan.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Ni djikankourouni djaman tou bé Olaf Trygvasson ka fangan kôrô, alé yé Norvègi djamana dé yé mi bé fè ka aka djamana bô Danemark ka mara konnon.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: A dèssè ni kô tchêfali kêlê la, Ethelred sonnan Olaf ka kohou man, o mi tou séguila Norvège djamana konnon kata aka massabo ko gnangnini ni siga siga kounawolo dô yé.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ye siguikolode ye mi baara logolo makogna kosson. A siguikolode baarala san waga kele ni keme nani ni binani ani nanila Massatche Sejong tere la (san waga kele ni keme nani ni tan ani segui kata bla san waga kele ni keme nani ni bilorou la).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mansa Sejong le té mansa nani nan yé Joseon ta douroula ro, do a kè mansa togo bo ni mansa djate ni yé.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: A damina la, a ka tôgô la ko Hangeul alphabet Hummin Jeongeum, mi kôrô le ko a kaan bèrè bèrè le ka môgôw kalan.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Koh ke tchogo tchaman behi mi ka Sanskrit la serikoh gneneman ya la. A kelele bé Nansara gnanamini Inde mogo ka dougou taga ke la boh tête ben na, ka taga Inde jamana la ni a ta kan ye.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ye kan kôrô dô lo ye min be se ka suma ni Latin kan min môgôw ba fô faragwèla.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Kitabu folo mi donnon douniyara ti sebara Sanskrit kan lela. Upanishadiou wolomani boroman kera sababouye Sanskritou dogoyara bonyadira kosson.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanscrit bè kan douman gbèlèman, mi worola indien kan koula tchaaman na, yomi latin worola Faragbgè kanw tchaaman la yomi français ani espagnole.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: France keilei banni koffei, Allemand Djamanan ye ilabain ka Dji tchaiman djamanan Bretagne minan.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Aliman Jamanan yé baga sariya-kounabô “Opertion Sealion”. Angilétèri Militèri kèlèkèminèw gwiliman ani stôckiw toun gnamatounou la touman min a tchè la kabô Dunkirk, i ko kèlèkèbolo toun dôgôya la.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Mansssara kounoug barayôrô fanga kabo alimanw tayé (“Kriegsmarine”) ani a tumbésé ka juguw ya bato nata sugubè tchin.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Tunbè, Royal navy côonou bà mi nou tounbè bèi saraka ko sorassi kountigui ba mou tounbè saranan ko allemand nou kanan ofaga oya sanfè benioka.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: An ye dantigekan fo Itali mogohou ka pilan na. Itali ti bey o Alemagni ni Zapon dogoni le ye.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Oka kèlèbolo ni oka kounoubolo ka dôgô, kassôrô o touka kounouba nani koura bara sani kèlè bé damina.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Itali jamana tigè gninsiyôrôw toun yé farafi jamanaw. Ka nounou jamanaw mina, o mako toun bèna kè ka tôrôntigè sèrè sôrô, o le la i'na fô sèrèw toun bé sé Miditérranéen kôkôdji tigè ani ka wili Afiriki kaman.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: da, mogow toukan kayele anglew ya bisi la ni egypti batola. Baraw kêrêfê, itali kêlêkê batow touteske ka fenwêrêkê.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Sissan, mini Japon tayé. Japon tè gouni djaman léhé, tôni inafô Bérétagni.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Dougoumanjikônôbaarafènw yé kouroun-ow mine labôra ka djikôrô taaman, ani o bi to o yôrô la lawèrè wakati hakè dô.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Môgôw tun be kèlè kè ni bato o ye mun be boli jii djukôrô tuma min nan o tun be dignè kèlèba fôlô ni dignè kèlèba filanan kèra. O wagati ra o tun ka suman ani fana o kisè bon fanga tun ga surun.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Lagèri daminin la o fanba tagamana kôgôdji sanfèla la, n'gua ina fô radari yiriwali damininna ani kèli lakika katimi djikônôn militèriw toun karabala ka taga dji dougouman ka o bali yéli ma.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Alimanw ya djidjoukôrô batow tunbé kiri ko U-Boats. Alimanw tun ka djisiralô ani kuwya djidjoukôrô batow boritchôgôlô fanani.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Djikôrô kulun kèlèkè féng n'a tôgô "submarines" sabou olu Alimanw dèmè kèlè la ka gnè, kèlè balé kôfè môgô shi te da'la n'a chaman be sôrô ou bolo tougouni.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Faassi! Massatchè Toutankhamon mi tou bé wélé “Massa Tout” tari “Démissin Massa” yé Egypti djamana massa yé mi togô lonni bi téréla.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Mi ka kan ka lon ni nan, o le ye ko a toun ma djate mogo togo tigi ye wagati djan timini la, a fana togo toun ma bla massakôrôw hou tcheman.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: ôla, aka kaburu yeli saan baakelen kêmê kônôntôn mugan ni fila kakê môgôbaye. Toumamin kaburukôrô tou sonyala, aka kaburu tangala kabô nagasiliman.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Tuttakhamum souhou dola ni fin nounou yé o tala sôrô famba tou kagni, ola toumbé sanoufin djoli djoli ani kabakouroufin gnannanman hou.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Sén èrèyon laman djoubô na Assiriyeinw ra wotoro fiyein yara, ka ayra tériya ido arôbein ka timi kèrèkèdénw ani wotoro tôw ra.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Bignin minw bora mako sa kala fè touw tè sè ka don djougou kèlè kèdin tanga nanfèn la. Baa kélé B. C. la, Assyrian morgorw ka kèlèdin so tigui man koulou forlor la don.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Sofaya kèrèboro dôléyé mi kèrèkèla sohow kan. Sèli touma dan fôron, o toumana Assyriyein sofaw tè kèrèkèla ahia sohow kôgbèw kan.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: an ka politikikɛla, lɔnnibagaw ni jadilannaw caman lɔ minw be bɔ gɛrɛci. Nasɔrɔ o ya mɔgɔ bɛ la mɔgɔw ka Homer le lɔ ka ɲɛ, ŋaara ba mi ɲɛ tu fiyen ni lo, mi ka gɛrɛsi jamana sɛbɛninmasalakulu ɲumanɲuman fila sɛbɛ : poyiw minw tɔgɔ ko Iliad ani Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Alibi, Sophocles ani Aristophanes yé gnatagali sèbèla tôgômaw yé ani ahi ra tiyatriw djatini dounougnan massalakourouw tchèman miw yé ahi bèrô bélébélébayé.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Grecquou ta lonni kela ba, jatikalan la na Togo ko Pythagore, mi lonna la teme na ta djati fanh Saba hou tagnongon tcge ko hou Kan.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Djate minan daman chaman be mi b'a yira môgô djate mi be Hindi kan fôla. A djaté minèra ko kan fila ani kan naani munui be fôla dounia kan bèè yé ko a be olu la.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Dougoukanfo bagaw da yé yèlèman la ni y ka kan missenouw mbolo a la.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Gnongon 340 million ka 500 million kouman fôlani wara môgô 800 million ohé kan minnan.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi ani ourdou o koumankan bé kéléyé nga a sèbèlikètchogo té kélé. Oya lownbé barokè obé gnongon ya kan min.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: San kèmèsi tan ni lorou dafè, Estoni saheliyanfan toun bé Aliman Jamana kôrôlensira kônônasouroukou kôrô.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Alimagni diina môgô ba dow tou befè ka Mari gbara môgôw là, ole koson ou ye Estonian kan labô.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: A toun bè Aliman o siguidémafin ni sèbèdé kélé “õ/ō” toun fara la kan.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ka soro wati be borira kumande tchaaman minu buora alleman kanna, o donan gnongonnan yoro. O kera sabu ka famuya wati ye.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: An derinako ye mi ye, massasigilan tchintala be na taga sorossidayara lekoli bani kofe.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: O bee, Charly ti gara karan ke Tiriniti univerisitera, Kanbriji, a ye antoropolozi ani arikelozi, o ko isituari, ni ka fila fila klasi filan diplomu sôrô.
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Anglais lou la Massa Bon'da Môgôw bèè la, Charles le follow ka kallan kè ka djalla (diplomou) sôrô.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turquie min be faragwèla (min be wele fanan ko Easter Thrace tari Rumelia min be Balkan dugu o ra min nunu lamini ni lo ni jii ye) be dugu kèmèjata saba lo bô.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turki dougou bognon têmèna kilometri waa kélén ni kêê woro kan (mili waa kélén) a djangnana ani kilomètri kêmê ségui (mili kêmê lorou) a lasouroula, a naka gwêlêni gnôngôna sêlêkênani sawoura.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turquie marah hou, ka fara baji hou Kan, o bé bon kilometere carré ba keme woronvla ni bi seegi ni saba le ta dougou koro djate ya la, (300.948 mi) Doh ni ta 755.688 kilometere carré, (291.773 mi) le bé Asie banabolo ni a tere ben bolo fan hou ye, ka ban kilometere carré 23.764, ni (9.174 mi) bé Nansara la.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Boyanra Tiriki is duniya jamana bi saba ni wolvilana leye, a boyan be yo Fransi Metiropoli ani Angile jamana.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turqui djaman la miniyé fan saba kôdjila: Kôdji Agéen térébéyôrô, Kôdji Fiman sanfè yôrô ani kôdji Mediterranéen dogouman yôrô.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Tarikou djamba lé be Luxembourg la n'ga ala kanhöröya kèra kabini 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bii bii nan yôrô dôw be Belgique yi mun tun be Luxembourg fôlô fôlô ra. Nga o kèra Belgique ya yôrôw o ye wagati min Belgiquekaw wili ra ka ban san waga kelen ni kèmè segi ni bii saba.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg ka a yèrè kè kounakolon djamana le yé, nga ahi bié ni a ka dounougnan kèlèba fila ro Alemanw bolo.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Sanji ba kele ni keme konondoh ni bilorou ni worofla la, Luxembourg ke la jamakulu sigi la doh ye, a bi togo le ye ko Nansara Jamana hou ta ton.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong yé tata halakini dôyé mi kèla bouddah môgôw ka monasteriyé mibé paro dougou sanfèlala.
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Môgôw ko san waga kelen ni kèmè wôrô ni bii naani ni kônôndô, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel ka bonbaw dan jango môgôw ko be djigui a ya se sôrô ra Tibetan-Mongol kèlèkèbolow gnèfè.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: San waga kélé ni bikonnondô ni kélé, tassoumanba dô ka Drukgyal Dzong segnoumanfindô inafô Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal foto.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Ta fala toumami tata ma tchin a fana gardé la ka kè Bhuthan djamana mi bé toutirstihou sama ka séhi.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Kèmèssi tan ni chégui, Cambôdji gbinninla siguignonnan fangaba tchèman, Thailandi ani Vietman.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Thais mogow tou bina cambodia djamana ka seyan tchaman folofolo wagati mi damina ni bè sanw ba tan ni wolofila ka taga bila san ba ta ni segui, o wagati san ba tan ni wolofila ani san dew biwolofila ani fila la ow ka Phnon Phen dougou tien pépé.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Keimeisi tanni séguinan ya sanlabanw nan, Vietnam tounka Cambodge Djamanan minan.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Ni ka mɔgɔ kɛmɛ ta Venezuela yi, mɔgɔ ta ni seegi te bara la. Minw fana be barakɛla o ya bara.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Venezuela môgôw fila sabananw mine bé baara kè bé a kè tén forobaara kônon, i ko kélén nanninan bé baara kè lizini kônôn ani kélén dourounan baara kè sènè la.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Lizini nafama Venezuelakaw yé bé tadji yé, yôrô mine a djamanan bi djôô djamana kôkanfééré baga yé, hali dôn kele kèmèna bi baara kè toulou lizini kônôn.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Sikhisimi yé diinan yé kabô Indien ow gounkoun tilebéfan ra. A lisiri bôla Punjab kinda ra san tanni lorou kèmèsi touman kabô sira bôgnôgôna Hindou laada fè.

text: Dinan sigui la kèmèsi tan ni dourou la Guru Namak fè (san ba kélé ni kèmè nani ni bi biwôrô ni konnondon- san ba kélé ni kèmè dourou ni bi saba ni konondon). Gurus ka konondon sonni tougoula gnon nabila la.

eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Demisɛn nuguw be to ka mankan sɔrɔ, barisa o “be faratiman kow kɛ, be kɛlɛ kɛ, ani te kuntigiw yaabu”, o be o kɛ ka o yɛrɛ hakili soroba, ikomi o hakili te se ka soroba ni fɛɛrɛsira gwansan ye.

eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Waatidjan Keneyamanya kow miw sababouyé dôlômiba bayé, bésé ka sé bangira bana ma, ani fiyentôya, walima saya. Farati minbésé kasôrô ala, abe buguyala sariyabilako dôlomikodjugukosson.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Linèti songon bé sé ka nôgôya dougnan djamanan la, mi wari man chia ani oya barakèla songon man chia.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Nga, café mi tchogo suguya tchaman lébé dunia konnon, miw kankan ka lôh.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Digan doun taman, ye ko ka djigui digan fani dougouman, waliman a lakolon dougouman.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Coûroûn fin ka dji tiguè, yirita, ni panli obè karan dôni koyé, ka djuman (ki la kuru yèrè, dji tiguè djoukrô wala ski alpine).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Hiring ayé fin dôyé gbéla, myé kè ka taganman kinninman, tumandôla sara fitinikan.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Téréfè randonné (tagama) bé kè djanyaw kan miw té kilométri fila bô foo katassé djanyaw man miw béssé ka ban tagamala lo kélé nan.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Téré kourou bèè ka taguamali la, tèmè yoror norgorma labinni fiitini kan ka kè, wa morgor sougou bèè min labènna bèsé ka kè.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Somôgô ni dén fitiniw, n'gua loon dô kènèma bi se ka nôgôya hali ni kôradén ani dénmarayôrô dénw.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Douniya beh djate ya la, bori djenkulu keme fila le behi. A fan ba beh bé kerena bara le kela.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Bori sinaya torohn, taga bori tourou rezo tan ani fila yelibori dibaga an ta bangu naniw la.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ani obô yôrô, bori Tours Barcelone ani Copenhague bori myé Copenhague, djonan faralà oka Prague bori Tour Prague ani otô.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Mogo kanka ka kow tchaman le djaté minan dougou tagaw ra.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ni ikakè tagamara, a kônon ko fénw té kéléyé inafô ko ahiyé so gnamima. Tagaborow, ladaw, domini, djago, siyôrôko, dansiguining, kan, ani fén gbèrèw béna kassi yôrôdow ra béna bô issigui yôrô taw ra.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ni ye fɛn dɔ ye min kan ka kɛ i hakili ra tuma bɛ, ni o kɛra i te na jigintanya sɔrɔ tari i te na ɲigi mɔgɔw ya ko kɛ ta ra.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Tagama barakèdaw bè ya kabini san ba tan ni conondo, Tagama barakèmogow lo kafissa wagati tchaaman ni mogo mi b è fè ka taga yoro mi a man we ta clakoyaw, o ta kan ani djaman mi ta soro man bo.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ali ni wayashi agensi befe ka wayashi kelaw caman ka commandi ta, barakelaw caman ka kala ke wayashi ke cogow ani taga yorow ta bolole ka.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Min ka nôgô o le ye ka bara kè ni barakèla dô ye min ka teli ka dugutaga dôw ko fô ka bila i n'a fô i taw gnôngô.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: I gnaman la flè baralakèla ka tagamaw djéni lé mayarala yala inerinèti do kan wa boutiki dô filèwo la.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Ni ya fè ka dunugnan yé ko akanôgô, manko ko, myé sondia, waliman myé nan kè, o sara béyé.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ni ka tagabolo ta, suguya fila lo beyi : kelen la i bé se ka bara kè tuma mi i be ta la wayasi la tari tô kelen la i be i dji dja ka dô bô i ya waribô la. Ni kumabolo siginin be labannan ta lo kan.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Môgô mun be fè ka nèèma, ni lafiya, ni lasinsinni fôlô saraka ka musaka kè i n'a fô wari be ban kan ka dugutaga baarakènafolo dôgôyanin jati minè.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Lahiri ba yira ko dougoutaga law te sognani kela, latige ke ba yere ni yoro ko kela logofieh terebali la, darike waliman ka mogo werew bla gna dowere Man o yere togola soroli kaman.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Touma chama dounando segue-segueyoro ye loyoro folo ye ni I be djigui kabo sannakourouni konnon, djikankourouni, tari borife gbele.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Dantchè dôw kônôn sisikourounw ya wèsèkèliw bé kè sisikouriun boli la ani i karadanté bèrè ka kan ka kè i bolou touman mine i bi do ni sisikourounw o kélé kônôn.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Soufe sissikurun konon, koudigui tche be se ka passipori be minan zango machi ka na toro a ya sounogo ra.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Tôgôsèbè yé faraliya tchogoya yé wiza tchogoya la. Djamana dôw kônon, i ka kan ka i sékan sèbè ani i siguini yôrô tchi i siguiyôrô faamaw ma.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Nin béssé ka kè ibe taga sèbèri kè sèbè dô kan kunda policiso la walima n'i tagara immigrasson birow la.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Sigiyôrô dunandjigiyôrô be nan môgôw tôgô sèbè (i djidja ka gniningali kè) jamana tchaman nan yôrôminan sariya ni gnôngô be sôrô.
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Boro gbèrèw kôrô, môgô miw té djadélôgôlôlaw chiyôrôwla donron lé bé tôgôssèbè kè. N'ga, obé sariya tô ladibi, ola i yé gninigalikè ka a vtchogolon ban.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Architecturi bé bara kè bow tchèyali ni ow lôtchogola. Yôrôdô bolôtchogo yé a damana gnandélôgô yé.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Sanga sohou ca man fleli be adama dew nouso ja waliman a fleli ke fenetri mi sigi cogo kagni, obe adama de nusƆ ja.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Bônlôcogo be jate filê ni forobadôw ni duguba miri, so kônôyôrô ni bakongo gnaniya.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Komi mɔgɔw caman yɔrɔ ka jan, i te nan mɔgɔw ye sufɛ kow la caman ni i ma ta Albuquerque tari Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Nga, casinos munu kofôle sanfè tan olu famba bèè be boisson féré, ani casinos olu chaman beto ka nâ ni tolonféng tôgôbôle baw ou ka yôrô kônôn (munu kabon bakè n'ou be Albuquerque and Santa Fe yôrô fanfè.)
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Kogo seberi ani pintiri miman kanu u be wele ko garafiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Boumerangui fliflili ye faamuyali sarama ye yandelogolaou be fe ka mi lon.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Metroplus kafisa katèmè ani atéfala té nga asongon katcha, ali ni a songon kanogoh katèmè térén biyéw kan faragbè djamananw la.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Ni I boko folo le kata djamana yiriwabali konnon tari kata dounougnan fan koura la I kana toloke tagabolow ni kewaliw yelemalila.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Dougou tagala waritigui faamuyanin tachama dessera douniya kouramayara ni a developeman man yoro mi ouna namoun fitiniw be se ka fara.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: kèrènkèrènnenya la ni i sera kura ye, i kan ka miri gnaminan i be nan i ya wari don faragwè kètchogow ra ani lotèli gnumanw, ni dumunifèn, ni makow jango i ye se ka i yèrè labèn ka kègnè.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Ni i be fè ka ta daga sigi kènè gwè la, i kan ka na ni daga dalan ye tari jôô ki i yèrè tanga saa, ni bunteni ni fen sugu nun kama.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Sôgômadafê, ibé café barakaman shaya î ya boon là, ani sourafê fana fê ibé fari lafoni thé chaman sigui.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Ika kè sototo ra, iyé wagati sôrôla ka iyèrè filakè ani ka miniti dôni sôrô ka fén kèreinkérein dô wouri.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ni ki yèrè fanba yé djanmanfè tigui, i ya mlan ka kè môgô timan yé waliman tuman dô kuman diman fôla.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: koulako la y seguiko to ka bo y ya lolo bara kè yoro la, y bè nan mi li kè feou do ye y bè sé ka daroka kè ni mi yé.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Ni yé dugu kônô ni seenko sugu tchanman, taga bari là waliman siguinanhu anglèw ya bari la mi itè tagalà ofè.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Minou man dégé drôtôsso kouman na, ka fô mibimla, ni mibè môgô tchanman mlan okôrô tè kélé.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Banakisébana yé bana mi juu yé pathogèni dôye, inafô virusi, bactérie, champignon walme parasiti gbèrèw.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Bana djudu yèlèmata yé bana minbé lasé nôgôya la ni awbé a djangarotô dôkôrô.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Govereneman tchaman be dunanw ani sigui gnongon tagabagaw ka boloci kè bana juguw koson.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Wagati tchaman o sariyaw bè ta tagaman djamanw kosson.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Charlotte ka Fèn kèlè min guèlè, North Carolina ahé fon gnaraman tchèman demayala.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Môgô mun siginin lo yôrô wèrè be to ka denbaya teriya ko fô jango o le yèrè kôsôn o taga ra o yôrô la, ka fara o kan dunanw hakili ra tuma kelen kelen môgôw be se ka o yèrè gnanagwè duguba tôgô la ni denmisèn o ye.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: San mugan tèmèni nan, demissèniw ka gnanawolomali da munu tunbé Uptown Charlotte o daman tchayara.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Denbayaw ma teli ka takisi ta Charlotte, hali ni tuman dɔw la mɔgɔ mako ba be se o man.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Doni tchaaya bé-i ni mobilikônônmôgôw timinan fila kan, o touman ni siugandiya sôngô toun bi sé ka tchaaya katimi mine ka kan.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antartica le djamana ye mi ninin ka bo ka timi dounouyan yoro bè kan, a djamana le kè ni ka South pole lamini.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Turisiya songon ka tcha, wajibi yékè fari fanga tigui ye, abé kèla téréma Nov-feb tuman dron nela, nga abe dan na Peninsula ani Islandi ani Rossi kôgôji le man.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Baarakêlà mogow waga filà djatéyà sigui là ya samian wagati là sigui yôrô bilorou bêrêmafê ho yôrô mârâ là, ho môgow dâbêrêma fitini tolà yé nainain wagati là.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antarctiki kônôn yé dougoukolo kôrôtanin barikaman dô datougounin ni galasi kilomètiri fila-saba.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Sanfe tagama loni kè baga douw bé taga djamana conon wagati douw la, ow be kourouka yèlè kè fo ka ssé kourou koun ka, fongnon li kè yoro do bè yé.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Siraba labènin min bè worodougou dougou kolo dan la yé kilomètèrè ba kélé ni kèmè woror tagamali ka bor McMurdo lorli rossi kôgô dji kan ka tagua dougou kolo dan la.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Abé nèji jija, ni sojigui falén djôndjônla. tagamaséré bilala mikan. A kèla tiguèla dakabanan katakata sababoula miyé doni faralén essenci ni dahirimèn fofola.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Nounou magaman tè okosson sira teimin yôrô djagnanra transantartic kourou koffei ka sôrô kassé plateau man.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Foroba akisidanw sababouya kounba foonènè ra ye siraw nama ye, sirakèrèfèyôrôw (kèrèfè tagalanw) ani kèrèkèrèli senpaaraw.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Hali ni i ko fohi te i bolo, i mako be samara ra min sentigèw ka gni. Samara mun be do tilen wagati ra ka teli ka yoroyoro galasi ni nèzi kan, nènè samaradjan dôw fana te se ka fohi gnè.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Djahani kanka ka dounya kossèbè, milimètri 5 (inch 1/5 ) walima donni besse kafara okan, ani feinw kankan kakei magaman ye neinin ra.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Boti samara ni crampon yé ani crampon franan oya fenw waman kana trinmin, gnannan fanba samala ni booti, crampons waliman ka duguman yoro ni kognan oyé kè a kélé nôn yé.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Seoun tonoliw ka kan ka bognan do a sourougnan dougoula. Tchin tchin, bèrèkolo, ani cogo (chloridi sodiomou) faizai nou yé kèla siraw ka alissa ka saaman li nogoya.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Djikourou ka beni tei fèè yé, Dji kourou chaman lo bei la gnongon kounan kouroudjigui la, nga a daman teimin lo bei be ni fanga yé.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Baasi bè minan olé gualasi kourou be nôrôla, o toumana a mako bè sougoubali la ka bin, sisan gualasi kourou dow ka binli bésé ka tow sougouba.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Touman dôw konon nan ban koo yèrè yèrè yé télé min bè galasi kourou yélén, touman dôw galassi kourou bénni dô lé, min ka tcha dôni, touman dôw koow dilan bali gbèrè lé, chien dô adama din dô lé.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Sanfine ye kelenw la soo paratali digisumanan fognon madjigini ye kossobe, mi be a koroyoro be tchela kanan kononon ka taga sanfe fan fe.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: U be sanfiye belebeleu bo tumado keme ni biworo, keme saba ni muga kilmetirira leri kekele na, ani ka fen gbiliman korota sanfe, ni ka u ta sanfiye tcheman.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: O be daminè i n'a fô tchôlôlô min be djigi ra ka bô kabasen fiyèn la, ba kan ka yèlèman ka kè “sanfiyèw” ye wagati min o be se dugumankolo kan.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Tigitigui VNP (viritiali doumoudougouma sisitèmi rézo) diilikèlaw yé bagali gnoumaman sira o fila politiki anbarigo ani jagokèyôrô IP-tintinni.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Hô Kafissa ni web proxies yé koro thchama lé kosson : obé inerneti sira bè yèlèma, http kélétè.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: O ka teli ka “bandwidth” ni mako kètchogo gnumangnuman di. Kodi be o kan tari môgô te se ka dogo ka filè ni nôgôya ye.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: kounafoni bow ta bara lé ka faniyan tiguè fe mi kè la koro mi kosson, ko o togo bè ko ka “sognan li gnankoro” tiguè.
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Tchannan, marayôrô sariyasounw nôn foyi lé bô suuya dagabali ladégili; disiki ladégi dônni dônni be na para fô gnouman fôtalan kélé kelé sanfè minw lasiri be na.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Miyé kakan kakè, oyé ka tinmin société nou oya lôgô flè, oya wari étagala yôrômi.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Komi wéléliw bé tèmèla Intèrènèti le kan, téléfoni sossiyété dô mibe aw siguiyôrôla tari aw be voyagi kata yôrô mi, amassé ko aw ka o tâ ka wéléli kè n'oye.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Gbèlèya tè y ka ko y yé y sigui yoro numero do soro ni y djetiguiw yé, i bè sé ka sateliti interneti soro Alaska yoro mi togo yé ko coungo conon sissè, y do numero do ta mi ya yira co y yé téléman yoro do lé ro.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Wagatidôw, i kahan ka nimoro mumè san adanna, mi kèra sababouyé PSTN téléfônouw yésé ki wélé; nimoro bôni yôrômi a farabassyara ni môgô miw yé iwéléla.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Masalabolo yôrônikelen bayèlèmali apilikatchônw - o ye apilikatchôn dôw lo ye mun be se ka dagnèkumasen kuturuw bayèlèmali kè yôrônikelen ka bô kan dôra ka taga kan wèlè ra.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Application dôw fan besse ka sèbè kuman nou yàràman lonan kan nan, noon ka waliman dounougnan fin yàrà, smartfone tigui bàbla alé finka.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Motèri falenniw toun dakala nônyara, ani sisan sôn be di katimi walima ka lakika falenniw dôgôya (ani kékoubali kouman katimi) , n'ga kôlôsi dôw bé kè, i'na fô o bé ala ka sé ka mumè fili sôrô.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Tumanbè, déni ou déni, ani déni wororkula, manko oya yèrè passeport là, waraman ka taga tugan la ni o worobaga passeport kan.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Ni y ka kè GPSi navigation application do y ya smartphone konon, wé bè se kè sababou yé i bè ssé ka navigate, ni y tè ya faso la.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Abésé wori mara kamassôrô karti koura ani GPS sényèrèkôrô bagarakèborifénw san ma wa ka kélé si'nga môbili lagamou djègnongna dô ma.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Ni intenet tiya portabli konon, ni téssé kiya portabli connecté, ô fari téssé kabô. A té sé kiya sira bô.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Nonkô Feerekèyôrô kénlé kénlé fani lé bé telefoni carti recharge sugubèla, miw bésé ka bila foroba telefoniw walma telefoni gbanzanw la.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Toumami carti chamaa nafa kabo wélélila douniya fan bê, dôhou danmatiguêlé don wéléli kiimènan diya sôninan kata dougou daman na.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Baara niniw besse ka lasoro toll-free telefonin nimero dola mi bisse ka wele telefoni chaman la wari te sara.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Fotow la Sariya ani video enregistrement bê bé kénléyé.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Ni fen fotota dron ma daga, o la enregistreri ma Kan ka lamiri.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: N'i be baara kèla ni droni ye, a maflè kossôbè djonala ou b'a tola iye féng mi dja tâ ani i kanka permit walma yamarousa sèbè mi be tâla.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Doroni bori aviyonso dô kèrèfè wa djama kouna, oyé miriya korong léyé wagati bè, ali ni amankè dagabali aw ya yôrô lô.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Bilama aviyôn wayasi dôrôpé maminèni koudayi kagwèlè aviôncompagni nônfè ni ama kè ni gninili ani sôngôw soumanni.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Wagati dama, alè aviyon tagama kélé béssé ka songon chama do farabassi ya rô sombagatô chaman yé ani abè sara ka djabili lagnini la ani ido gna mala aviyon djègongonya intèrnèti kan ido sôrô ka tôgôsèbèkè.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Kabiri i manko tountè tourisi visa sourini sigui wala affairi, katayé wala international lakolidè yé, manko wati djan siguini kokataga ali tourist yalatigui.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Wagati tchaaman, toli djaman gbèrè fo ka mien, o bè sé kè fo y yé via le soro folo do soro ka do.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: A chaman na kalandénw ya visa chariya ni a gnini tiogow bôlé visa guazan walima businèsi ta ma.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Djamina fanba be ra i mako be ke lekolisso sebe ta zango i ye se ka karan ke a konon. Ani dalou ye ke iboro mi be a yere ko ibesse san kele fere ke ni bassi te bo la.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: A be fè ka taga kalan kè dugu minan a ye o baaradaba ni dunandon kubeda gnininga ka lôn a mako be na se fenw fenw man.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Kafô kibé diplomati yé, nibé barakê dogougbêrê ybé na taxi sraa dougouni bé la.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Obé nisôngôn mi bô môgô ya sôrôta la o tatchogo te kélé ye diaamanaw shi kônôn, ani nisôngôn dama ani dän bôle gnôgôn ma diaman bè kônôn.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Federali dugu dôw la, i n'a fô Ameriki ni Canada, lènpo min be ta sôrôda kan be sara federali dakun ni yôrôsigi dakun nan. O kôsôn, a sôngô ni a dabôli tchogo be se ka yèlèma dugu bè ra.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: wagatimi lonan ladoli seguè suèguè fôni wa lada dô wagatimi ibara sé ifasso la, duwagein fessèssèli béssé kè fitanayé.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: I fariya ka lôn ibissé walama itéssé kana ni fèn miyé. Ota bôni kô fènw kowfô chariya sirankan.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Tèmèsira mi kanôgô ka iyèrè bila wayasiw sèbèlila, oyé ka aw lontaw fisaya wayasi interineti bilayôrô grupu dô lasiguini kan.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: N'i deguera formateli sèbèli corigé la internèti kan, o kôfè, i bissé k'i yèrè ka siti internèti dulan.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Ka bara douw kè ite sârâ sôrô mi na ka i to voyagi sira la o bè i franbachiabo mogow touw man, nga a tè ka kognouman ke doron.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: La le djamana gbere la, la ke yere gnini bara kela ye nii yere ta diagne ye, o le be sira ba nafaman ye, ka seko ani lonko tchaman famou, djamakulu kura lon, yere lon, ani ko tchaman lon ni hakiri kura soro ye.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Ni kêkognan bissé ka kê barakênafolo yêguêli nafaman dôyé, ina fô ka sigui djagnan yôrôdôla sabou saratanouw ka bara chama lébi garidjigai chiyôrô ni taboulola anis ara dôni.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Viking kèrèkèlanounou ka russi dji tchètiguè ka taga kôkôdji fiman ani kaspièn kôkôdjila. A sra dô bé sé tala bi. Ka flè kagnin ni môgômako be kèrèkèrè pèrèmi di la, pèrèmi mi sôrô mandi.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Baltici kôgôji gweman sira tugula Artici kôgôjiba ni baltici kôgôji, Omega baji, ladoga baji fê ani Saint Petersburg, anibaaw ni bajiw fê.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Onega salan (banin) ayé nronyé Volga la, kabô fo kôdji là myé tinmin ayé kêla Russie djamana la.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Aya bla akonnon ko ni a séla Les Maina la ko bé na gnannabô a gnan kôrô. A bé nan môgôdôhou yé mimobiri tiguihou lalô ko fô oman ko obé odjigui oya yôrôla ani o bénan kounafoni tlan na yé.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: A daminala I be sebe noro yorow la ka ika demin koofo mogow gnana, kato ka gbere kounou lo yorow dala, ka gbere mogow mi be oka kourouni djossila, djidja ka gbere kourounbolilaw la doumouni yôrô kônôn, ani...
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: A lkorobo la kuma mogo tchaman ye, a se ko dan. Sani wagati doh tche, mogo kele kele beh beni lon ka ban ka fen hou taga tchogo di man, yo kurunb bé mogo gnini nan gnami man.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Aw kankan ka aw la sanakurun Frequent Flyer sugandi ni akili yé sosiyété djekulu baw fè.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Hali a ka kè y gnannan ko y taga le ka di i degui ni yé avionso mina, yé alo fanani ko avion sow ta nana boni gnongon ma, tougouni, douw bè kow dia i la katimi ka i to avionso djèkourou kélé konon.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Aviyon djègongonyaw inafô Emirates, Etihad Airways ani Turkish Airlines bara ahi bagaradaw rôssama kossôbè farafina dougoubaw rô gnongondan damaw ma katimi Erôpou aviyon djègnongonyaw kan.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Kabini san 2014 Turkish Airlines bei djigui dougou bissaba ni kônondon lekonon farafina Djamanan bissaba kon'non.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Ni voyagi toumana dô b'i bolo, ibe billè mi san kata Farafina o songon comparé ou be billè mi wélé "round-the-world fare" k'a dôn moun kacha.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ka na gnanran ka wari myé farala farani visa kan, taga taxi (wari myé sarala) , duguman tàa anidô, tu yôrôbè farafi djamanan.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Ni I be fe ka duniya gnala sankuru kataga worodugu fana, daman be ke tagayoro ka soro osiyan siraou ma tchaa.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Touman dô, bèli éssé kèla fintchinman, téré wiriyôrô South Pacific miyé Santiago de Chili kataga Tahiti, miyé LATAM avion tarafonyé.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: San 1994, Nagorno-karabak mara mogow kabouoh Azerbaijan djamanan ra, oye kèlè gninchi Azéris mogow man.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Disitiriki mumè tôgô toun dara ina fô UNESCO Diyan Tchièn Baarayôrô a ya kôrôlensira dôrô ni galé galé danbé sabou la, ani a marafé danbé-o bi djamana sankôrôta maraféw tchèma.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Ahi tôgô bilani UNESCO dounougnan tchien lissi kan.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: San tinminan, môgôw ka trrassiw lôw nikôrôssi yé fani kan, tuu lôni djani boro èrè fan nan myé kôgôdji fan balà.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: A ka dawou la tiguiya faan dor yé yéta dèsè min bè sosiyete yiri wali la. siraw, sisi kourounw ani dji kan kourounw bè dougouw tougou yongon na, ka soror mobiliw tésé kow soror ka bor kènèma.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Faramanchia donni bei Belgique ni suisse djamanw ya francais kan ni France yèrè ta tchiai, obeinata obei be gnongon famou.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: kèrènkèrennenya la, jatiminè sisitèmu min be Belgique fan yôrô min tubabukan be fô ani Suisse yi kètchogo misenw dôw gwè ni tè mun nin faransi tubabukan te kelen. O la tugu kumadenw dôw fôtchogo ti kelen ye dôni.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Nga, francais bè myé Belgique kan fôla ani Suède kan oka francais karan lakolossola, oyéssé ki famu ni kan francais fô ani djatéli la.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Dunignan mara tchaman konnon, yaariyaariya yé teriyanôh dôyé, minbé a yira ko “inisôgôma”.
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: O bèè n'a taa, Malèzi kônôn, Malèzi môgôw tchèman dafèdougou-ow kônôn, a kôrô be “kôrôlôn”, ka kan ni djalaseere kourouma farisogo nônfè, waléya mine bé kè Erôpou djamana dôw kônôn, ani a ka kan ka kè o lagnini dôrô yé.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Yomi, Anglais mi taga la Espagne djamanan la, we tigui bé se fili ka teguè la wili ko ambè bessira li kè baga man (we touman fè a le yèrè toun ka kan ka fo ko dansé we gnan man) ni i ka kè seriko la ka bo yoro do ro.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Kan missinw walima kan la dlan niw bè kè ni miryia lé yé ko ka kouman gnongonya la nogoya mogow ni gnongon tchè, kan mien gbèlèya toum bè yoro mi na.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: O franan francas kan nan, myé natural waliman organic kanw mi bènankè sababuyé myéssé ka koman kuman fôlanw ani kan tôwu.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Téré faryani kônnon, wayasikèlaw bésé ka jinaji kôrôbô kaa yira komi uka dji léyé (walima fen wèrè).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Miw bessé kè faratiyé ni tagaman kèla ka miragi nôgbèn, ido bônon bérika nafaman ani dji tôto ra.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Hali tchignè gbanniba béssé ka soumanya ton sou fè, ni y man ninin fani gnama do i bè sé sa ninin bolo.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Téréman fè, sanko, i manko béna sosso kôrôssila nika sarati ta kata yara toufi konnon.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Hali ni i bi mobili boli ra subttropic touba konon, kômi-ow dama dô ni daw yèrèni touman mine i bi dona boli fé kônô bi wasa wakati ra sosow ye ka do bolifèn kônôn ni i ye.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Kɔnɔninw ya murasɔgɔsɔgɔ, hamantee mi wele tiogo bèrè bèrè be grippe aviaire ye, o béssé ka kɔnɔninw ni dantafɛnw minan.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: A fola ko adjateya mi ka mogow soro o man mogow waga kélé soro, nga o doouw fato la.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Môgô chaman mi toun be baarala kabama féngw fè olu toun b'ala, n'ga masouba dô be ka gnèshi môgô munu be kônô kalan.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Mi bèni Norvègi man alougou lé fjords djanw yé ani kourou wotchèw miw yé barala ka sira di dougou koro kôrôtani djan, ka bognan walima ka dôgôya.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Fougan kene togo larra ko “vidde” mi nougou ye kenegbe ba ye ani yiri te yoro mi na ani da te yoromi na.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Dougouba fonnon yé Nyirangongo takoulou yinrin djouba ani farafina kouroula gorille nonbô songon douman yé.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Glassikourouw maa bassigui, n'ga obé yéléla kata koulouba dougouman. Olébé nani pinrinlidaw yé, diguin missinniw, glassikourouw bé miw gnamadogo.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Djikourou kokow ni a kounanfeinw besse ka bin, ani a tchidaw béssé ka datougou.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Jikru baw be kari kabo sanfe yorora ni ka ben nasoro u be pan wala ka kologolo kabo sanfe yorora.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Turusimu wagatiw ka teli ka bougou kulu gaariw la Indienw ya tile bô ba wagati ra.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Oh koffei, Oh kofféi, ninnin wagati tunmanan, tchèkagni ani kônonkagni obéyé, ni sanfè kuru mikônon nègui ani mu bènan skii kè samara lamani ani yiri tani.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Avion socété kélé kélé lé bè sou ta wari koffo, wé lé bè tiguè ka bô soukoya coyagi miniti-laban sôngô.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Avignon sossiété mi bé môgôhou dinminla té bé Air Canada, Delta Air laïni, Lufthansa, aviyon mi bé nan ka bô Etats Unis ani Canada ani Westjet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: A kakei gnan oh gnan ikan'ka ka wele kei telephone nan ka iya manminanri kei.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
